game.name: Last Remnant, The (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)(Disc 1)
game.desc: In this Xbox 360 role-playing game, Remnants are sources of power that provide a definite military advantage to the faction that owns them. It is in this context of war that the sister of young Rush is kidnapped. What follows is an epic quest to find these artifacts of power, to discover who wants to take over the world.
